title: ForecastPlan: what the reasoning agent returns for one part. Owner: Codex AI (producer), Codex Fin (consumer: engine.runPlan). Change only by agreement in docs/TASKS.md.

service_level.description: Policy table default by criticality: S 0.99, A 0.975, B 0.95, C 0.90. The agent may move it by at most one step and must say why.

inputs.description: Driver adjustments the agent proposes. They are written to forecast_input with source='ai', status='proposed'. See forecast_input.schema.json.

insurance_spare.description: True when the part has little or no demand but serves S or A equipment with long lead time. Engine keeps min 1 and says so.

rationale.description: Plain engineering English. Every number in it must appear in the evidence pack.

evidence.description: Evidence ids from the pack, e.g. 'series:4100101639', 'pm:PX_KT-383A#3', 'po:7711'. The validator rejects ids that are not in the pack.
